# Recovery phase checkpoints are payload-dependent
P1 pattern: an applied checkpoint proves the previous payload reached the provider, not that a later edited retry did. After receipt failure, skipping the provider solely because status is applied can acknowledge new values while old values remain active. When retry inputs may change, bind checkpoints to payload identity or reapply the current payload idempotently for every incomplete operation before completing its receipt. Same-payload retry tests will miss this; exercise changed values after the provider/receipt failure boundary.
